pass_a_gloss: §15 dual gloss: ἀνεπικούρητος / without-help · ἀνεκποίητος / unsellable · ἀφηγούμενος / leader … Pass A scaffolding ≠ Pass B continuous English. Theme: Missed redemption year; nations always redeemable; Mary’s good portion; Ezekiel leader.
pass_b_english: Cyril: …having been walled, and girded with the helps from above, and having city minds, and not having been ignorant of what seems good to God, then having neglected the fitting, having thrown away from easiness the lot apportioned to themselves, and having fallen out of the very hope, unless they should sober out from their drunkenness, according to what has been written, and take up again the own things, of the year of the ransoming having stood in—that is, of our Savior’s sojourn—they will remain thereafter, and will continually underlie the one having bought, that is Satan. ‘For behold,’ (Luke 10:42) he says, ‘you have been sold by your lawlessnesses, and by your sins I have sent out your mother.’ (Isaiah 50:1) And the multitude of the nations being altogether without-help, and sick with the rustic and unlearned mind, in this way also having been thrust toward the slavery under others, is redeemable through all, with God pitying; for it will take up the own lot having been called toward freedom, in the year of the release, when Christ released all the under sun from the greed of the demons, and took out from the snares of the sin, and has justified in faith, and has sanctified in spirit, having abolished by his own cross the handwriting against us, and the Levitical things unsellable; for the lot has been kept safely for the saints, and they have the hope firmly set. And indeed upon the most learning-loving Mary Christ somehow said, that she chose the good portion, which will not be taken away from her. Yet of small and great priest and people, and of all simply the ransoming in Christ and the firm of the hope.

Palladius: So then Israel will sell-out the own lot, not having recognized the year of the ransoming; yet the nations will be in possession of the hope, and a taking-up again of the goods of the nature will be through Christ.

Cyril: Thus I say; and the God of the wholes will seal our word unto the true also signaling this according to another manner, through Ezekiel’s voice, in the measuring-through of the house: ‘Thus says Lord: If the leader should give a gift to one from his sons, from his inheritance, this will be for his sons; or to one of his servants, and it will be for him until the year of the release. And he will give back to the leader, yet of the inheritance of his sons for them it will be, and the leader will not take from the inheritance of his people to tyrannize them from his possession, from his inheritance to inherit for his sons, in order that my people may not be scattered, each from his possession.’ (Colossians 2:14) So then is the oracle clear for you, and is the mind of the history seen bare?
Palladius: Least; and I would learn as most sweetly.
Cyril: He calls leader, O Palladius, the high priest, the one allotted to lead the peoples under hand. So then since fitting and exceptional lots have been distributed to the holy (Ezekiel 46:16–18)
